name: Castrillo Mota de Judíos (Spain)
description: White field with a red stripe near the top and a blue stripe near the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castrillo Mota de Judíos (a castle, a Star of David and an open book).
history: Municipal flag of Castrillo Mota de Judíos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castrillo Mota de Judíos arms — castle, Star of David and book
